text.tspan: Let’s get the living and abiding, operating word
Into our hearts! Into our hearts!
Let’s get the living and abiding, operating word
Let’s read the Bible! Take in the pure milk!
And by it we will grow—oh, taste and see,
God’s Word, the Bible! God’s Word, the pure milk!
Yes, by it we will grow—oh, taste and see!
